# Stock SO-101 parts (do not edit)

These are the official SO-101 part files from [TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100), copied unchanged from commit `5f6d2b876a53a4872e405b991dd925556c9e38a4` and licensed Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

- `STEP/` has one file per part. Files used by both arms are at the top level, and arm-specific parts are in `Follower_Specific/` and `Leader_Specific/`. Open them in Fusion with File, then Open, then "Open from my computer".
- **Printing:** the ready-to-print STL plates are large (about 70 MB) and depend on your printer, so they aren't copied here. Download the plate for your printer (Bambu A1 mini, Ender, or Prusa) from [STL/SO101](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100/tree/5f6d2b876a53a4872e405b991dd925556c9e38a4/STL/SO101), or single parts from [STL/SO101/Individual](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100/tree/5f6d2b876a53a4872e405b991dd925556c9e38a4/STL/SO101/Individual).
- **Full assembly** (20 MB, useful for seeing how everything fits): [SO101 Assembly.step](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100/blob/5f6d2b876a53a4872e405b991dd925556c9e38a4/STEP/SO101/SO101%20Assembly.step).
- **Simulation model** (URDF and MuJoCo): [Simulation/SO101](https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100/tree/5f6d2b876a53a4872e405b991dd925556c9e38a4/Simulation/SO101).
